items.label: Current office
items.text: California State Treasurer since January 7, 2019. (sources: California State Treasurer's Office https://www.treasurer.ca.gov/comm-external-urls/fiona-ma-bio.pdf [search summary, primary]; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fiona_Ma [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Offices held
items.text: Member, San Francisco Board of Supervisors (District 4), 2002–2006; Member, California State Assembly, 2006–2012, including Speaker pro Tempore 2010–2012; Member, California State Board of Equalization (District 2), start year reported as 2014 or 2015, through 2019, and chair in 2016; California State Treasurer, 2019–present. (sources: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fiona_Ma [search summary, secondary]; Ballotpedia https://ballotpedia.org/Fiona_Ma [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Earlier career
items.text: Appointed to the San Francisco Assessment Appeals Board in 1995; earlier a district representative for then-State Senator John Burton. (sources: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fiona_Ma [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Education
items.text: Bachelor's degree in accounting, Rochester Institute of Technology (class of 1988 per an RIT alumni profile); master's degree in taxation, Golden Gate University; MBA, Pepperdine University. (sources: California State Treasurer's Office https://www.treasurer.ca.gov/comm-external-urls/fiona-ma-bio.pdf [search summary, primary]; Fiona Ma campaign https://fionama.com/about/ [search summary, primary]; Rochester Institute of Technology https://www.rit.edu/news/alumni-update-treasurer-has-passion-helping-underdog [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Professional license
items.text: Licensed California Certified Public Accountant since 1992. (sources: Fiona Ma campaign https://fionama.com/about/ [search summary, primary]; California State Treasurer's Office https://www.treasurer.ca.gov/comm-external-urls/fiona-ma-bio.pdf [search summary, primary])

items.label: Party registration
items.text: Formerly registered as a Democrat; changed registration to Republican in 2024. (sources: Spectrum News 1 https://spectrumnews1.com/ca/la/politics/2024/09/04/gloria-romero--former-democratic-state-senate-leader--switches-to-gop [search summary, secondary]; Los Angeles Magazine https://lamag.com/news-and-politics/democrat-turned-republican-gloria-romero-declares-candidacy-for-lieutenant-governor/ [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Offices held
items.text: Member, California State Assembly (49th District), elected 1998, served until 2001; Member, California State Senate, March 2001–November 2010; Senate Majority Leader (years reported as 2005–2008 in one source and 2004–2009 in another). (sources: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gloria_Romero_(politician) [search summary, secondary]; JoinCalifornia https://www.joincalifornia.com/candidate/6069 [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Career
items.text: Professor emerita, California State University, Los Angeles; has served as California state director of Democrats for Education Reform. (sources: California State University, Los Angeles https://www.calstatela.edu/univ/ppa/newsrel/pkp-gromero.htm [search summary, secondary]; The Federalist Society https://fedsoc.org/contributors/gloria-romero [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Education
items.text: Bachelor's and master's degrees, California State University, Long Beach; Ph.D. in psychology, University of California, Riverside. A Cal State LA page also lists Barstow Community College. (sources: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gloria_Romero_(politician) [search summary, secondary]; California State University, Los Angeles https://www.calstatela.edu/univ/ppa/newsrel/pkp-gromero.htm [search summary, secondary])
